steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
steps.checkEn: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Parker Solar Probe 近距離研究太陽日冕與太陽風。
knowledge.textEn: Parker Solar Probe studies the solar corona and solar wind at close range.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以距離平方反比估算入射熱通量，區分表面吸收、反射及實際溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate incident flux by inverse-square distance and separate absorption,reflection and actual temperature.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 理想點源近似 S(r)=S1/r²，r 以 AU；吸收功率 αSA。溫度還受放射率、視因數及導熱影響。
knowledge.textEn: Point-source approximation S(r)=S1/r² with r in AU;absorbed power is αSA. Temperature also depends on emissivity,view factors and conduction.

quiz.question: 「熱流邊界」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Thermal-flow boundary: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付距離功率表、熱流圖及尚缺放射與導熱資料的清單。
若把到日心距離誤用成距太陽表面高度，平方反比輸入失去一致定義。
optionsEn: P=680.5 W absorbed;power is not temperature.
Deliver distance-power table,heat-flow diagram and missing radiation/conduction inputs.
Using height above the solar surface instead of heliocentric distance breaks the inverse-square definition.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若把到日心距離誤用成距太陽表面高度，平方反比輸入失去一致定義。 與本階段判準一起判讀：能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Using height above the solar surface instead of heliocentric distance breaks the inverse-square definition. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.

steps.title: 熱流邊界 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Thermal-flow boundary · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「熱流邊界」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Thermal-flow boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若把到日心距離誤用成距太陽表面高度，平方反比輸入失去一致定義。
對照「熱流邊界」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。熱設計需同時交代入射與散熱路徑；本課量級結果不作真實隔熱盾或試驗設定。
本階段必須重驗：能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
steps.instructionEn:
Using height above the solar surface instead of heliocentric distance breaks the inverse-square definition.
Against the nominal Thermal-flow boundary result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Thermal design requires both incident and rejection paths;these scales do not specify a real shield or test.
Reverify this criterion: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若把到日心距離誤用成距太陽表面高度，平方反比輸入失去一致定義。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Using height above the solar surface instead of heliocentric distance breaks the inverse-square definition.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
steps.checkEn: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.

steps.title: 熱流邊界 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Thermal-flow boundary · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「熱流邊界」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Thermal-flow boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付距離功率表、熱流圖及尚缺放射與導熱資料的清單。
在交接件中加入「熱流邊界」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以距離平方反比估算入射熱通量，區分表面吸收、反射及實際溫度。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver distance-power table,heat-flow diagram and missing radiation/conduction inputs.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Thermal-flow boundary: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate incident flux by inverse-square distance and separate absorption,reflection and actual temperature. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 能量方向完整，不能把低吸收率直接等同低溫。
steps.checkEn: Energy directions are complete;low absorptivity alone does not define temperature.
